name: search
description: Full-text search of PANGAEA earth/environmental science datasets (oceanography, climate, geology, biology, paleo). Returns dataset title, DOI, authors, year, and topics. Use for questions like "ocean temperature datasets", "Arctic sea ice cores", "CO2 flux measurements".

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. "ocean temperature", "Arctic sea ice". Omit to browse everything.

name: dataset
description: Full metadata for one PANGAEA dataset by its numeric ID (e.g. 921708).

name: dataset_by_doi
description: Full metadata for one PANGAEA dataset by DOI (e.g. "10.1594/PANGAEA.921708" or the doi.org URL).

name: recent
description: Most recently published PANGAEA datasets (newest DOI registrations first).

days.description: Only datasets registered within the last N days (optional).

name: facets
description: Aggregate matching datasets by a facet — top values of a category field (e.g. "agg-mainTopic", "agg-author", "agg-method", "agg-location", "agg-campaign") with counts. Optionally scoped to a full-text query.

query.description: Optional full-text scope for the aggregation.
